faqs.question: Can you provide dedicated SAP resources?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer skilled SAP functional, technical, BASIS, HANA, and integration resources on monthly or project-based engagement.

faqs.question: Do you support SAP S/4HANA and ECC?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our resources support SAP S/4HANA, ECC, SAP Business One, and multiple SAP cloud and on-prem modules.

faqs.question: Can your resources work onsite or remotely?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible engagement—onsite, remote, hybrid, and shared support models based on business needs.

faqs.question: Do you provide 24/7 support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our dedicated support resources work in multiple time zones to deliver round-the-clock SAP support.

faqs.question: Is training included?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide user training and resource-based knowledge transfer to ensure smooth operations.
